instruction: Respond to a customer asking about a late order
context: Order #4521 shipped 5 days ago and has not arrived
response: We apologize for the delay on order #4521. We have escalated this with our carrier and expect delivery within 2 business days.

instruction: Respond to a customer requesting a refund
context: Customer bought a defective headset last week
response: We are sorry to hear about the defective headset. A full refund has been processed and will reflect in 3-5 business days.

instruction: Respond to a customer asking about return policy
context: Customer wants to return an unopened item
response: You can return any unopened item within 30 days of purchase for a full refund. Just include your order number with the return.

instruction: Respond to a customer asking to change shipping address
response: We have updated the shipping address on your order. It has not shipped yet so the new address will be used.

instruction: Respond to a customer asking about a discount code
response: We understand the code expired recently. As a one time courtesy we have applied a 10 percent discount to your account.

instruction: Respond to a customer asking about subscription cancellation
context: Customer wants to cancel monthly plan
response: Your subscription has been cancelled and you will not be billed again. You can continue using the service until the end of this billing cycle.

instruction: Respond to a customer asking why their account was locked
response: Your account was temporarily locked due to multiple failed login attempts. We have sent a password reset link to your email.

instruction: Respond to a customer asking about warranty coverage
context: Product is 6 months old and stopped working
response: Your product is still under our 12 month warranty. We will send a replacement unit at no cost to you.
